movie.title: Night of Blood
movie.overview: Six strangers enter a cash-prize endurance challenge at the Val Verde Hotel, a location infamous for a fatal explosion and rumors of being haunted. Instead of being stalked by a physical, masked serial killer, the contestants face immersive, supernatural scares when the hauntings at the hotel turn out to be all too real.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Six strangers enter a high-stakes endurance challenge at the infamous Val Verde Hotel, only to discover that the haunted rumors surrounding the venue are terrifyingly real.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Six contestants gather at the Val Verde Hotel to compete in a cash-prize endurance challenge at a location scarred by a deadly past explosion. Expecting theatrical tricks and a staged serial killer, the group is caught off guard as true supernatural phenomena begin to manifest. As atmospheric terrors escalate into deadly encounters, drama unfolds among the competitors battling for survival. Ultimately, they must confront both the hotel's tragic history and their own deepest fears to endure the night.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Driven by the promise of a massive cash prize, six strangers arrive at the abandoned Val Verde Hotel to participate in an extreme endurance contest. The location carries a dark history, having been the site of a devastating fatal explosion that left behind persistent rumors of hauntings. Initial lighthearted competition quickly turns tense as psychological friction arises between the desperate contestants. Expecting a typical staged haunted house experience with actors playing masked killers, the group initially dismisses early eerie occurrences as production stunts. However, the atmosphere shifts dramatically when supernatural manifestations grow increasingly volatile and impossible to fake. Unexplained phenomena turn hostile, trapping the participants inside the hotel's crumbling, dangerous interior. As the terrifying spirits of the hotel's tragic past target the contestants' personal vulnerabilities, former rivalries dissolve into sheer panic. The line between game and reality completely vanishes as they struggle to maintain sanity amidst relentless spectral attacks. In a desperate race against time, the survivors must unravel the hotel's horrific secrets to find a way out before the deadly night consumes them all.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Night of Blood is a gripping horror-drama that follows six strangers competing in a high-stakes endurance challenge set within the sinister Val Verde Hotel. Infamous for a tragic explosion years prior, the hotel serves as the ultimate spooky backdrop for a cash-prize contest. While the contestants anticipate manufactured frights and actor-driven scares, they are unprepared for the genuine supernatural forces lurking within the ruins. As spectral hauntings materialize and psychological tensions mount, the participants must navigate deep-seated personal conflicts while fighting to survive an authentic paranormal nightmare.

story_structure.climax: The supernatural activity reaches a fever pitch as the hotel's terrifying history fully manifests, confronting the remaining contestants with an overwhelming paranormal threat.
story_structure.conflict: The contestants realize that the challenge isn't just a staged, psychological test, as genuine supernatural events begin occurring within the hotel's walls.
story_structure.resolution: The aftermath of the night unfolds as the survivors reckon with the terrifying reality of the Val Verde Hotel's hauntings and the ultimate cost of the contest.
story_structure.introduction: Six strangers arrive at the infamous Val Verde Hotel to participate in a high-stakes, cash-prize endurance challenge, unbothered by the location's tragic history and haunting rumors.
story_structure.risingAction: As the spectral encounters intensify, tension mounts among the participants, forcing them to navigate escalating life-threatening scares while trying to survive the night.
